competency.practice_task: Produce a lesson, coached exercise and blind learner transfer test grounded in an evidence-to-claim audit table.
competency.setting_constraint: Fix a time, memory and energy budget before the run.
required_evidence: a lesson, coached exercise and blind learner transfer test
Include resource log and quality per unit of compute.
Report number of supported and unsupported mechanism claims with uncertainty or an explicit deterministic check.
Construct a negative control for the failure mode: inferring cognition directly from an fMRI correlate.

assessment.scoring: Each criterion: 0 absent, 1 partial, 2 demonstrated; require 2 on all four.
assessment.threshold_policy: Register the metric threshold, baseline, task budget and evaluator before exposing new items.
criteria: Concept: correctly state the assumptions and limits of neural evidence limits.
Practice: the learner succeeds on a new case without the answer key.
Measurement: report number of supported and unsupported mechanism claims against a matched baseline with reproducible inputs.
Critical check: test for inferring cognition directly from an fMRI correlate; detect it or rule it out with evidence.

competency.source_policy: Reviewer must add a verified primary source before lesson status; no source is fabricated here.
competency.contamination_policy: No private items, answers, seeds or reviewer-only prompts in this public specification.
